verdict.rationale: AutoGen's evidence covers agent creation, teams, orchestration, and AutoGen Studio for building/testing teams, but there is no mention of any version control, review/approval workflow, or rollback mechanism for automations/agent configurations. Migration guide between major versions (0.2.x to 0.4.x) is a one-time framework upgrade path, not automation versioning or rollback. Missing for 10: version history of agent workflows, review/approval gating before deployment, rollback to prior automation states, audit trail of changes.
